## Summary
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/useValidTestTitle`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule has a [**safe**](/linter/#safe-fixes) fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**warning**](/reference/diagnostics#warning).
- This rule belongs to the following domains:
  - [`test`](/linter/domains#test)
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`jest/valid-title`](https://github.com/jest-community/eslint-plugin-jest/blob/main/docs/rules/valid-title.md)
  - Same as [`vitest/valid-title`](https://github.com/vitest-dev/eslint-plugin-vitest/blob/main/docs/rules/valid-title.md)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"useValidTestTitle": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Enforce valid titles for unit test cases and test suites.

Checks that the titles of test blocks (`describe`, `test`, `it`) are valid:

- Titles must not be empty.
- Titles must not have accidental leading or trailing whitespace.
- Titles must be string or template literals.
- Titles must not contain disallowed words (if configured).

### Valid

```js
it("should work", () => {});
describe("my suite", () => {});
```

## Options

### `disallowedWords`

A list of words that are not allowed in test titles. Matching is whole-word and case-insensitive.

Default: `[]`

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"useValidTestTitle": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"disallowedWords": [
							"skip",
							"only"
						]
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```
